name: Project NexOS
detailed_description:
A modern-day narrative mystery where players explore a seemingly ordinary laptop to uncover hidden layers of conspiracy, surveillance, and stolen data. Blending investigative gameplay with branching choices and a grounded tech-thriller tone.

Uncover the secrets hidden in plain sight

When you pick up an old laptop at a local car boot sale, you’re not just getting a bargain - you’re inheriting a digital pandora's box that will put you in the sights of powerful and influential entities. What begins as idle curiosity quickly escalates into a high-stakes investigation with global implications.

Project NexOS is a modern-day mystery adventure where every click, search, and discovery pulls you deeper into a tangled web of conspiracy. Navigate a custom-built operating system designed to both conceal and reveal. Recover deleted files, decode encrypted messages, and piece together the events and stories of those who vanished trying to expose the truth.

Features:

  • Explore a fully interactive desktop filled with emails, documents, and hidden programs.

  • Solve layered puzzles that rely on observation, deduction, and real-world logic.

  • Uncover a dynamic story shaped by your choices, where the truth is never simple and the consequences are real.

  • Navigate a tech-thriller world filled with secret organisations, whistleblowers, and digital activists all with their own objectives and interests.

  • Experience an atmospheric journey that blurs the line between fiction and reality, with some subtle (and not so subtle) narrative branches and multiple endings.

  • Embrace your autonomy and forge your own journey. With no right answers, your decisions are solely yours to make.

Will you play it safe - or chase the truth, no matter the cost?

Behind the Scenes - A Promise to You

  • No content in Project NexOS was created using AI. All visuals, audio, and written material were made by real people.

  • The game includes no analytics, tracking, telemetry, or data collection of any kind. If a future update introduces optional crash reporting or gameplay analytics, players will be clearly informed and given the choice to opt in.

  • Every puzzle and piece of information needed to complete the story is contained entirely within the game. There's no need to search third-party websites or external resources — everything you need is right in front of you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL 3.3+ or Vulkan support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan 1.2 / OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Intel or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with Metal 3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0
  • Processor: Intel or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Metal 3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distro released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARMv8
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL 3.3+ or Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distro released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_64 with 4 physical cores or ARMv8
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan 1.2 or OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
